title: HOD Pack
description: The official mod pack used on HOD Minecraft Server!
body:
The official mod pack for the HOD Minecraft Server. 

This mod pack includes various mods to give a vanilla+ feel to the server and boost QOL to the player.

Mods included:

- Accessories: allows players to wear elytras with their chestplate. Also a dependency for other mods.
- AntiFreecam: added to combat player exploiting Freecam.
- Easy Shulker Boxes: allows players to access contents of their shulker boxes while in their inventory.
- Elytra Trims: allows players to dye and add trims to their elytras.
- Horse Expert: allows players to see stats of horses.
- Open Parties and Claims: allows players to create parties with other players and claim their territories to keep them safe from other players.
- Xaero's Minimap & Xaero's World Map: added to give players and world map and mini map to improve QOL. Paried with OPaC and players can see their parties and claims on the map.
